Alongside some small balancing updates and fixes, we've also added 3 brand new tanks thanks to Community feedback.

 -

[b]Total Tank Simulator Update Patch Notes - May 4th, 2023[/b] 

- New Japanese units added;[list]
[*] Officer Tank Destroyer Type 1 Ho-Ni II 
[*] Tank Destroyer Type 3 Ho-Ni III (Replaces JagdPanzer IV in Japanese Campaign)

notes.title: Total Tank Simulator - 12th May Update
notes.notes:
Hey Total Tank fans, 

The team have been working on the latest update to bring you all an even easier way to change the battlefield with a brand new unit editor and customizer. Read our full patch notes for all the changes in the latest update! 

[u][b]
Patch Notes [/b][/u]

[b]NEW[/b] Built-in unit editor and customizer:

	- Ability to create units from within the game
	- Ability to assign custom meshes to tank parts
	- Unit preview
	- Exporting customized units to the workshop from within the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/f439ebabe1e9b91637308700858e0bdf6a723a01.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/179f5c3da9981feeade6810490af077127066805.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/cf7e4d2b4a823e8bce81b30917c5190ba1c84237.png[/img]

[u][b] Optimizations[/b][/u]

	- Disabling additional rendering cameras when not used
	- Game logging overhaul: reducing the number of log messages being recorded in order to avoid game slow down in some situations
	- Optimizations to unit and terrain detail rendering code
	- Adjustments to physics simulation parameters
	- Reduce computation when units die, especially when the first unit of a certain type dies
	- Use more efficient methods of performing physics overlap & collision detection
	- Scale down LOD texture sizes to reduce RAM usage
	- Force unloading unused assets after battle scene is fully loaded
	- Project texture audit in order to avoid texture duplication in RAM & VRAM

[u][b]Bugfixes[/b][/u]

	- Fixed issue with units being repaired by dead recovery vehicles
	- Fixed exceptions being thrown occasionally on unit death
	- Fixed issues with mount / dismount mechanism

If that's not all you can join the fun today for 60% off as part of the [url=http://505.games/TTSUpdate]Steam Daily Deal! [/url]

Until next time! 
Noobs from Poland & 505 Games

notes.title: STEAM WORKSHOP - UNIT CREATOR [VERSION 1]
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

As hinted a few weeks ago we continue to enlarge the Total Tank Simulator experience!

2020 has been a very intense year for everybody, obviously we were excited and anxious to deliver our first game. Little we knew that we were going to do it in the middle of a global health crisis experiencing situations we could have never thought of.

Once the game was out and we could get your feedback, we have enhanced and updated the game for free with new content and features in regular basis and we also delivered the Italy DLC. 

The latest manoeuvre was to implement Steam Workshop to allow players to introduce some playable content into the game.

Today, we are very happy to let you know that we are bringing a new free update to the Steam Workshop to allow modders to create and share their own units! and we wanted to bring this before the end of the year! 

After reviewing amount of ideas and feedback the community provided back in Spring we thought a good approach was to let players create their own units and missions. We are eager to see all that creativity crystallize.

We have many ideas, but we do not have set plans for 2021, as we told you, this has been a quite intense experience and we are really looking forward to the upcoming holiday season.

We will be resting a little while we watch how the evolution of TTS performs. 

As usual, please, let us know your feedback and suggestions, we might not be able to answer things instantly as a lot of us take break now until the 4th January. 

We want to wish you and your families great holidays, peace, and health! 


[h1]GET STARTED CREATING UNITS[/h1]

To get started please read our guides here [[url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1e1qACKniYP50vlVbV7TAhmgAEBFJe_TC]STEAM UNIT WORKSHOP GUIDE[/url]]

[b]If you have any issues specific to Steam Workshop please feel free to email the team here, please note this will only be monitored for workshop related enquiries: ttsworkshop@noobzfrompoland.com [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/1f3c71f93927fc9756c1b067d5cc526c28df2b6f.png[/img]

[h1]CHANGE LOG [/h1]

- Added support for custom tank models loaded from mods that can be created using our Blender > Unity3d pipeline.
- Support for custom soldier poses in tanks imported from mods
- Game data has been repackaged in a more efficient type of storage (asset bundles) in order to support modability and improve load times.
- Reduced build size by deduplicating some data common for the base version of the game and DLC
- Fixed issues related to mod enabling / disabling / updating.
- Fixes in mission workshop UI and mission editing

notes.title: Total Tank Simulator - Initial Workshop Release & Guide
notes.notes:
Hey Total Tank Fans

The post launch evolution of Total Tank Simulator continues! 

Thank you again for the survey responses you kindly provided earlier this year. We identified areas of interest to tweak and enhance the TTS experience. Over these 5 and a half months we implemented performance improvements and fixes, added content and features for free (more units, slow motion, pre- battle orders, etc) and a paid DLC to introduce a new faction. [b]Today we are excited to announce another free addition: Steam Workshop! [/b]

Today’s content update introduces the [i] first [/i]installment of features that allow players to create unit deployments on sandbox, also to create and pack collections of sandbox missions that can be published and downloaded. We planned this as a first integration of Workshop features that will permit the community to create their own content and expand the game as per their imagination… and we’ll keep working on the backend to introduce new workshop capabilities. We are sure you have more questions: when will that happen? What else will be introduced? Will it be free or paid?

For now we rather not compromise on times or content, please, stay tuned. What we can confirm is that the next Workshop drop will be free as well! We will be making updates to the workshop over the next days as we find out about possible issues. If you have any trouble please check out our pinned support post. 

We hope you enjoy today's update and please read on for the guide and patch notes!

Noobz From Poland and 505 Games

[h1]PATCH NOTES [/h1]

- Added a workshop mission scenario editor where players can create custom scenarios for other players to play
- Added manage mods section in the workshop editor to allow players to control which mods are enabled & in which version
- Added scenarios section in the main menu containing the scenarios created by other players.

- Known issues: for now the Italy DLC faction should for not be used in the workshop editor.


Hey, this short guide will show you how to create a custom mission scenarios that you can upload to Steam Workshop and share with other players. 
 

[h1]SCENARIO MISSION GUIDE 
[/h1] 
 
Creating new scenarios 
 
1. To create a new mission scenario first go to ​“Workshop”​ in the main menu.  
2. Then select ​“Edit scenarios” 
3. You will be presented with a list of scenarios that you created. Initially that list will be empty. Click the ​“Create new”​ button at the bottom. 
4. You will be prompted to enter the Steam workshop mod name. This name will be the one visible on the Steam Workshop page. ​NOTE: this name cannot be changed later, so pick wisely. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/7e4187291a0449c692107db4d5b80ce5ec758ff8.png[/img]
 
5. Next up, assign Scenario name & description: 
 
 
 
6. After that, it’s time to create some missions. Use “Add” button in the middle column to add new missions.  
 
7. Choose mission name & description at the top of the right panel: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/7bb77712f37320b6bfb28c9d1a654360f80dcd59.png[/img] 
 
 
8. When a new mission is created, you can configure its various parameters the way you would in Sandbox. Additionally, it’s also possible to create VIP-protect & VIP-kill missions as well as Wave survival missions: 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/581d2cf5b7300e9f7aa4c6520510178a664c66f7.png[/img]

 
9. Select the remaining options such as the map, factions fighting, 1v1 or 2v2 or FFA. Note that those options cannot be changed once units are deployed​. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/f19487cf7e5879e0208167e5a35e5a9f589f4019.png[/img]
 
 
10.Use ​“Start” ​button to begin deploying units. The map will begin loading. 
 
 
 
11.Once, on the map you should be presented with the following interface: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/5b0a2da5ef4605d29d4393d0659d738f5cf72cbc.png[/img]

 
12.Yellow and red prompts at the top remind you which side is the player’s side and which sides will be the enemy sides.  
 
13.Buttons on the right allow you to save your deployment, discard changes and switch between waves (in wave type missions). 
 14.Use ​“Switch to testing”​ button at the top to enter mission testing mode. In this units any changes to the deployment will be temporary - you can for instance deploy units that the player could deploy and see how the result plays out. 
 15.Use ​“Switch to editing” ​button to go back to deploying units that will be part of the saved mission. 
 
16.Additionally, in wave missions you can click on the Wave icon to open this panel that enables switching between different waves of enemy units: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/788dcb14ec219186bc9773840ddeaea82b896f71.png[/img]
 

 17.Once you’re ready, click on the ​Save icon ​on the right to save changes to your deployment. 
 
The prompt will make sure you want to close mission editor (the changes will be saved). You land back in the scenario editor inside workshop. 
 
18.At any time, you can click “Save and close” button on the left to save your changes to the scenario to disk and exit the workshop editor. 
 19.Once your mission scenario is complete, you can click ​“Upload to Steam”​. If no errors are found, the scenario will be uploaded to Steam and an overlay for your new Workshop item will be opened. 
 
20.You can make changes to your scenarios and use “Upload to Steam” again to upload new versions of the mod. 
 21.NOTE​, even though you are the mod author, the mod will not be automatically subscribed for you. You have to follow the same steps as are listed in the “Play a scenario from workshop” section. 
 
[h1]PLAYING SCENARIOS FROM WORKSHOP [/h1]
 
1. Locate a Workshop scenario on Steam and click ​“Subscribe”. 
 2. Make sure you restart the game. 
 
3. Steam launcher should download the scenario on your drive. 
 
4. After you launch the game, the scenario should be available on the list under “Scenarios” button in the main menu. 
 
5. NOTE, you can adjust which scenarios are enabled or disabled in the “Workshop” > “

notes.title: Latest Patch Now Live
notes.notes:
Hey all 

As mentioned last week, the team have been working hard on implementing some improvements from launch feedback last week. With our first bigger update which is live now! 


[i][b]Changes: [/b][/i]

In addition to graphics quality settings, CPU performance settings that control the strain on the CPU have been added

The updated version should automatically determine the best default settings for both GPU and CPU performance levels. However, at any time it will be possible to switch those settings to something else.
The CPU settings will control the following aspects of the game that have an impact on CPU usage:


[list]
[*] Number of particle systems: spawning (explosions, trails, smokes, debris from buildings)
[*] Number of particles in each running system (explosions, trails, smokes behind units etc.)
[*] Explosion colouring the environment
[*] Explosion deforming the terrain
[*] Whether infantry ragdolls are enabled on death
[*] How long do ragdolls last after death
[*] How long do machine gun bullets travel
[*] Limit accuracy of colliders around infantry bodies when viewed from a long distance
[*] Reduce the number of sounds played and processed
[*] Disable fly-by sounds
[*] Spawning fewer trees on maps
[*] Control the limit of units on lower settings.
[*] Reset Button Added after game is over - to make it easier to restart in Sandbox. 
[/list]

As always thank you for your support in Total Tank Simulator - please check out our pinned posts on the Steam Discussions if you wish to provide further feedback or need assistance!

notes.title: Day 1 Patch and Upcoming Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey Total Tank Simulator fans,

Thank you for all your support on launch yesterday, it’s been a very busy day for the team! 

We’ve been reading all your feedback and suggestions and understand some users have been experiencing issues - rest assured our team is listening to all your feedback to make Total Tank Simulator as enjoyable as possible. With us working on optimization ASAP. Please read on for our upcoming plans: 

[h1]TODAY 
[/h1]
First of all the team is gathering as many log files as we can to identify if any errors or exceptions are happening during the game that could affect performance.

We’ve noticed some of you are posting issues in comments - please check the pinned[b] ‘How to report issues and bugs’ thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/674500/discussions/0/2248931052737842234/]here[/url] [/b]which now includes updated guidance on How to gather log files for Total Tank Simulator. This information will help us investigate any problems - which in turn makes the game the best experience for you! 

We will also push a change later today that adjusts the number of units that can spawn in the battle in accordance with the quality settings chosen by the player.

[h1]NEXT WEEK CHANGES[/h1]

We are working on getting an update out to you all early next week - 

In addition to graphics quality settings, we will add CPU performance settings that control the strain on the CPU.


The updated version should automatically determine the best default settings for both GPU and CPU performance levels. However, at any time it will be possible to switch those settings to something else.
The CPU settings will control the following aspects of the game that have an impact on CPU usage:
 
[list]
[*] Number of particle systems: spawning (explosions, trails, smokes, debris from buildings)
[*] Number of particles in each running system (explosions, trails, smokes behind units etc.)
[*] Explosion colouring the environment
[*] Explosion deforming the terrain
[*] Whether infantry ragdolls are enabled on death
[*] How long do ragdolls last after death 
[*] How long do machine gun bullets travel
[*] Limit accuracy of colliders around infantry bodies when viewed from a long distance
[*] Reduce the number of sounds played and processed
[*] Disable fly-by sounds
[*] Spawning fewer trees on maps 
[*] Control the limit of units on lower settings.
[*] We also plan to look into gathered logs to determine if there are any errors or exceptions that could impact the performance. 
[/list]

Keep an eye out on our latest news feed for when this patch goes live. 

[h1]UPDATED SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS[/h1]

We have adjusted our system requirements from further testing and feedback, to more accurately represent minimal sufficient gameplay. 

Minimal:
RAM: 8GB
CPU: Intel Core i5-7600K
Gfx: NVidia 960
Recommended:
Dysk: SSD
RAM: 16GB
CPU: Intel Core i5-8600K
Gfx: NVidia 1060  

[h1]FURTHER OPTIMIZATION PLANS 
[/h1]
We understand there are areas within our game engine & game where we think we could improve performance by creating a customized solution that better suits our game instead of using a built-in general solution. This will be ongoing work from the team as the game progresses and we will be sure to update you all with any changes and improvements. 

-
Thank you again for all your support, we look forward to hearing your continued feedback and sharing upcoming plans with you. See you on the battlefield! 

Noobz from Poland & 505 Games

notes.title: Release Date Announcement - Take Command May 20th!
notes.notes:
Hey Total Tank Sim fans, 

There's a lot to be [i]tankful[/i] for today as we release our brand new trailer and let you all know the burning question? When can you get your hands on Total Tank Simulator! 

[previewyoutube=ShWt5KyRap8;full][/previewyoutube]

505 Games and Noobz From Poland are all set to release Total Tank Simulator on Steam for PC [b]Wednesday, May 20. [/b] ːsteamhappyː

Total Tank Simulator is a passion project brought to life from Noobz from Poland and began as a small scale handcrafted demo released in 2016 which quickly drew the attention of players around the world!

Offering a unique way to experience some of the most pivotal moments in world history, Total Tank Simulator is a battle simulation game offering an explosive combination of a physics-based gameplay and historically accurate content ([i]sort of[/i]). 

The original experience has since evolved to a full launch packed with [b]three exciting game modes [/b] and dozens of totally destructible maps through the lens of six nations, each with a unique campaign.  

You will take on the role of a commander of one of six nations in each campaign, strategically deploying massive armies before watching the physics-based engine playout the battle with real-world accuracy. Setting itself apart from other titles, Total Tank Simulator encourages players to be a part of the action, allowing direct control of individual units – from tanks and planes to snipers, soldiers and more. 

Hundreds of historical and classified units and weapons are carefully detailed with environments that are completely destructible from the Sahara Desert to the green fields of Europe and the snowy plains of Russian Taiga and beyond. 

Three distinct gameplay modes will appeal to different players and will challenge players to be strategic and creative, including: Sandbox Mode, Shadow Mode and Campaign Mode each with six historical nations to play as.

After years of development shaped by your community feedback, 

[b]Total Tank Simulator will be available on the Steam for PC on Wednesday, May 20 for $19.99/€19,99/£16.49. ( local prices will be available ASAP ) [/b]

But that's not all! 

You can also save 10% off by purchasing Total Tank Simulator during the games launch week, a resulting reward of 505 Games’ wish list campaign:

We can still achieve the final reward of 25% off if cleared prior to launch! Please share with your friends and get them to wishlist today. 

As always thank you for your feedback, be sure to chat with us here or on our[url=https://discord.gg/totaltanksimulator] Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/TotalTankSim]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Total_Tank_Simulator/]Reddit[/url]. 

- Noobz From Poland & 505 Games

notes.title: Frequently Asked Questions: Total Tank Simulator Update!
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

Thank you so much for your support on our Wishlist Campaign announcement! 

We've put together a Frequently Asked Questions list to get you ready for TTS. 
[i]
We can't tell you a launch date *just* yet but our team are working hard for a 2020 release. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31059066/9c01eb0054868163bf057267c194c6bac53bb19b.png[/img]

So here is the latest! 

[u][b]Should we expect Steam Workshop compatibility? [/b][/u]
A possibility in the future! 

[u][b] Will beta testers get a discount? [/b][/u]
There will be no particular discount for beta testers however we have our Wishlist Campaign to reward all our fans - we've already hit Tier 1. 

Check out the following tiers and the discounts available: 

• Tier 2: 75K wishlists = Secret Weapons or Special Tactics units + Officer Units + 10% release discount (1 week).
• Tier 3 150K wishlists = Secret Weapons or Special Tactics units + Officer Units + 25% release discount (1 week

[u][b] Where can I wishlist Total Tank Simulator? [/b][/u]
You can wishlist TTS over on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/674500/Total_Tank_Simulator


[u][b]How much will Total Tank Simulator be?[/b][/u]
TBA. The game has grown so much, the content has more than tripled since our first demo! 

[u][b]What are Total Tank Simulator’s minimum PC requirements?[/b][/u]
You can view the minimum requirements on our Steam overview here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/674500/Total_Tank_Simulator/ 


[b]Please note this is an estimate from the development team. [/b]

[i]
Minimal:
RAM: 8GB
CPU: Intel Core i5-7600K
Gfx: NVidia 960

Recommended:
Disk: SSD
RAM: 16GB
CPU: Intel Core i5-8600K
Gfx: NVidia 1060[/i]

[u][b]
What languages does Total Tank Simulator support? [/b][/u]
US, UK, GER, FR, IT, SP, RU, POL, BR-PT, JAPANESE, KOREAN, SIMP and TRAD CHINESE.
With some voiceover in US, UK, GER, FR, IT, RU, PO. 

[u][b]Will *certain weapon* be featured in the game? [/b][/u]
You’ll have to wait and find out - don’t worry we will be previewing a lot before release! But if there's anything in particular you want to see, let us know! 

[u][b]
What nations will be featured? [/b][/u]
6 Factions - UK,US,GERMANY,FRANCE,POLAND and USSR. 

[u][b]Will Total Tank Simulator be coming to other platforms/ MAC, LINUX?[/b][/u]
At this stage, the focus of the development is Windows only.

[u][b]Will there be DLC’s after the initial release? A modern-era DLC has been mentioned on Steam.[/b][/u]
The plan is to bring some additional content post-launch! 

It’s shape or form, delivery date or whether it will be paid or free is still TBD. Our decision is heavily dependant on the performance of the release and the feedback of the community.

[u][b]Will there be navy battles in the future? [/b][/u]
Not in the current plans.

[u][b]I’ve found a bug! Where is the best place for me to report this?[/b][/u]
The current build is very different from the last available demo. So far you can let us know on the Steam forum. When releasing the game we will point to specific channels. 

[u][b]Can I play the demo? [/b][/u]
We are going to be removing the demo soon from your libraries to get ready for release! Keep a look out for any events and footage to see the latest content. 

[u][b]Is Total Tank Simulator going to get a multiplayer mode?[/b][/u]
We have considered the possibility but for the planned release we will focus exclusively on single player.

[u][b]How will the campaign be structured? Will it be structured similarly to the one teased in the latest Demo?[/b][/u]
In Campaign Mode, you will have the possibility of choosing one faction out of 6. 

Each nation has a variable number of acts (some offensive, some defensive), Each act will have different battles and you will have some options in choosing different paths to the final victory, whether you want to fight every single battle of take the shortest route to the final confrontation.

The available battles will be under different conditions: your tech tree will be limited on the first stages and you will need to develop it between battles.

Sometimes you will be required to totally defeat the enemy, while on other occasions you will just need to survive an incoming number of enemy waves or, perhaps, destroy to protect specific units! 

After each battle, you will be awarded resources according to your performance that will allow you to research new units and acquire forces for your next battle. 

You can replay a battle that you lost but, most likely, you will have fewer resources left so you will need to plan very carefully to turn the tide of war.

[u][b]How many units can we expect per nation?[/b][/u]
A lot, the number of units is variable per nation but in the game, there are up to 200 different units in-game!

We will be updating from our side however our Fandom community have a  up to date list here: https://total-tank-simulator.fandom.com/wiki/Units 

Make sure to keep up to date on all things TTS here and over on [url=https://discord.gg/dCsRwfx]Discord[/url] & [url=https://twitter.com/TotalTankSim]Twitter[/url].

Thank you again for all your support - The Noobz from Poland and 505 Games Team.

Jerry Kotos

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Dear Community ;)

After over 2 years of developing the game I finally have a solid release date:
15th AUGUST 2019.

It gives us confidence we will be able to polish the game and deliver the best version of TTS possible. Also that date is a special day in Poland - Armed Forces Day!

Full version will have an awesome sandbox with more or less 4 game modes, 200+ units, infantry, 6 factions.Also we want to introduce an innovative singleplayer campaign. 

We have decided to drop multiplayer. We added it to the last demo. First of all it was not as popular as we expected, secondly adding multiplayer to the full version would increase dev time. Since our goal is to launch the game in 6 months time, we made that call.

As for the price? We are still thinking about it. Might be 15 USD or so.

Thx again for being a great community and following our game for the last 2 years. It was hell of a ride for us. 
I do hope that TTS will meet your expectations.


You can watch TTS development over the last 2 years / all 5 demos and a glimpse of full version here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uUYek2IgTW4&t=1s 


Jerry Kotos,
Noobz from Poland
